build_text_features: build text features by encoding label templates into normalized class embeddings using a CLIP model
run_evaluate: run zero-shot evaluation on a dataset using a model, tokenizer, templates, and labels
validate_zeroshot: validate a model on a dataloader using zero-shot image-text cosine similarity classification
load_metadata: load dataset catalog, templates, and labels JSON files from a metadata directory
compute_accuracy: compute top-k accuracy over predictions by comparing output logits against target labels
